extracted.name: Whiskey Sour
extracted.description: I recently tried to make a whiskey sour. There are only a few ingredients, but it seems that recipes vary the ratios. I think I have found the perfect combination.
ingredient_lines: 2 oz a good bourbon or whiskey (I used Jack Daniel’s Gentleman Jack)
2 oz simple syrup (You can make your own syrup by heating 2 cups sugar in 2 cups water until all the sugar is dissolved)
1/2 Egg whites from 1 large egg (This is optional but recommended as it gives a great head on the cocktail)
Orange slice and maraschino cherry for garnish
instruction_lines: To a tumbler add whiskey, lemon juice, simple syrup, and egg whites. Put lid on tumbler and shake vigorously for 15-20 seconds. Pour contents over crushed ice in a glass. Add a maraschino cherry and a slice of orange. Serve and enjoy. For something different I used a blood orange for my garnish.
